title: admin-system settings.jsonc
description: Runtime configuration for the admin-system CS2 plugin. Mirrors the Settings struct in src/Core/Config.hpp - missing keys fall back to their C++ defaults; wrong-typed values fail the whole load.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity. NOTE: currently declared but not consumed by the plugin.

locale.description: Default panel/translation language; matches a file in configs/translations (e.g. "en", "ru").

tag.description: Stable identity of THIS game server in the shared database. Must be unique per server and must never change once per-server admin grants reference it.

name.description: Human-readable name registered in the servers table (auto-upserted on boot).

defaultBanReason.description: Reason recorded when an admin bans without specifying one.

warningThreshold.description: Number of warnings before escalation logic triggers.

templates.description: Quick Punish presets shown in the admin menu. Invalid entries are skipped with a warning in the server log.

duration.description: "perm" (or "0") for permanent, otherwise <n>s / <n>m / <n>h / <n>d. A bare number means SECONDS - prefer an explicit suffix.

reasonPresets.description: Preset reasons offered in the manual menu punish flow (a free-text "Custom..." row is always added).

menuDurations.description: Rows of the menu duration picker (same grammar as template durations).

abuseProtection.description: Automatic admin-freeze rate thresholds, counted across ALL servers sharing the database. A threshold of 0 disables that counter; root ('z') admins are always exempt.

enabled.description: Master switch for AUTOMATIC admin freezing; manual !freeze_admin always works.

windowMinutes.description: Sliding window (minutes) over which an admin's actions are counted.

broadcastPunishments.description: If true, every issued punishment broadcasts a colored line to all players.

tagAdminChatMessages.description: If true, an admin's chat is re-emitted with their group's colored prefix.

fallbackPrefix.description: Prefix used when an admin has no group prefix set.

reports.description: Player-to-player reporting (!r / !report). Reports are inserted into player_reports for an upstream website; nothing is surfaced in-game.

cooldownSec.description: Seconds a reporter must wait between two reports of ANY player. 0 disables.

duplicateWindowSec.description: Seconds during which the same reporter cannot re-report the SAME player. 0 disables.

allowCustomReason.description: Adds an "Other..." row prompting for a typed reason (stored with reason code "other"). The in-game input is capped at 64 characters.

reasons.description: Rows of the reason picker. Entries missing either field are skipped with a warning.

code.description: Stable grouping value stored in player_reports.reason_code.

label.description: Fallback menu text, used only when no report.reasons.<code> translation exists.

timeoutSec.description: Seconds the suspect has to comply before the timeout action fires.

autoKick.description: If true, auto-kick on timeout; if false, just unfreeze and notify the admin.

kickReason.default: Failed to comply with cheat check

panelRefreshMs.description: How often (ms) the center-HTML panel is re-sent. Values above ~200 make it visibly blink or vanish.

moveToSpectator.description: Also force the suspect to spectator (not just freeze) so they can't keep playing.

bannerImageUrl.description: Optional online image (https) shown atop the panel; leave empty for no banner.

fixedLink.description: "fixedLink" mode: the single URL shown to the suspect. Also the fallback for websiteAutoRoom.

websiteAutoRoom.description: "websiteAutoRoom" mode: the plugin POSTs here to create a per-check room. Backend-agnostic; string values may contain {steamId} {playerName} {adminSteamId} {adminName} placeholders.

authScheme.description: Value prefix before the key; "" sends the key verbatim.

requestBody.description: Body POSTed to your API; placeholders substituted per check.

playerUrlField.description: Dot-path into the JSON response holding the suspect's room id/URL.

playerUrlTemplate.description: {value} is replaced by playerUrlField; leave empty to use the field value as the URL directly.

checkerUrlTemplate.description: Optional checker URL relayed to the calling admin.

presenceUrl.description: Presence poll GET; {code} = raw playerUrlField value, {steamId} = suspect's SteamID64. Empty disables polling.

presenceField.description: Dot-path into the poll response holding the in-room flag.

pollIntervalSec.description: Poll cadence in seconds; also the worst-case delay before a join is noticed.
